svg.text: Serial vs. Parallel ATPG Scan Pattern Simulation in GLS
Balancing Full Chain-Shift Hold Verification (Serial) Against High-Speed Pattern Regression (Parallel Backdoor Deposit)
1. Full Serial Scan Simulation (Must Run!)
- Requires 5,000+ slow `scan_clk` shift cycles per pattern to load
stimulus serially via primary Scan-In pins and unload via Scan-Out.
Runtime Cost: 100x slower! Cannot run 10,000 patterns serially.
What ONLY Serial GLS Catches
1. Actual Scan Chain Connection Integrity (`SI -> Q -> SO` broken
wires, accidental inversion inside P&R scan-reordering!).
2. Scan Shift Hold Violations (Short wire `Q -> SI` under MIN SDF!).
3. Lockup Latch Polarity & EDT Decompressor / MISR Compression!
Rule: Run 5–10 Chain Test + Stuck-At + At-Speed patterns SERIALLY!
2. Fast Parallel ATPG Simulation (High Volume)
$deposit / force all 5,000 SDFFs in 0 ns (1 step!)
- Writes scan load bits straight into every internal FF `.Q` via
PLI/force, toggles 1–2 capture clocks, and checks FF values out!
Runtime Speed: 50x–200x faster! Runs thousands of ATPG patterns!
What Parallel GLS Catches (With Blind Spots)
+ Validates Stuck-At & At-Speed Launch-Capture (`SE=0`) timing.
+ Verifies X-Masking (`X-source` traps inside combinational clouds).
- BLIND to broken physical `SI -> SO` chain routing, scan-shift hold
races (`SE=1`), and OCC/PLL preamble sequences before capture!
Rule: Combine Serial (sanity/shift) + Parallel (bulk patterns)!
